description: Moves, renames or re-invites a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes. Only the fields sent change. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it.

duration_minutes.description: How long the call lasts, in minutes.

invitee_ids.description: Everyone to invite: replaces the invite list. At most 25 of them may be people not invited yet.

notify_invitees.description: Whether invitees get an email about the change. Defaults to true.

occurrence_start_time.description: Start of the occurrence that scope this or this_and_following refers to (RFC 3339).

recurrence.description: RFC 5545 RRULE to repeat the call by, such as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO.

scope.description: Which occurrences of a recurring call: all (the default without occurrence_start_time), this (the...

start_time.description: When the call (or the chosen occurrence) starts now (RFC 3339).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the recurrence follows.
